message.content:
Here’s a quick list of well‑known documentaries you might enjoy:

| Title | Release year | Synopsis |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** (2006) | A former U.S. Vice President presents climate science and urges action. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** (2017) | Updates on progress since the first film; focuses on policy changes. |
| **“Before the Flood”** (2019) | Leonardo DiCaprio travels worldwide to explore impacts of climate change and solutions. |
| **“Climate Change – The Facts”** (2020) | An accessible overview of evidence, causes, and mitigation strategies. |
| **“Our Planet”** (2019) | While broader than just warming, it shows how rising temperatures affect ecosystems globally. |

All of them are available on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, Disney+, or via purchase/rental from iTunes/Google Play. Let me know if you'd like more detail on any particular one!
